protocol.selection: All returned NFL main-line ranking rows across passing/rushing/receiving/receptions that have fresh exact two-sided prices and both candidate/baseline pregame inputs. No side, score, probability or outcome filtering. One quote per market/game/player; ambiguous targets excluded.
protocol.timing: Freeze before kickoff. Compare both fixed models using the same frozen completed-game population and 48-hour prior-result lag. Exact input vectors, residual-artifact hashes and forecasts saved. No fitting or tuning in this script.
protocol.scoring: After exact official final: conditional OVER Brier excluding pushes, OVER/UNDER direction hits, fixed >=55% conditional win and >=3% EV research selections, unit ROI refunding pushes, paired fixture-cluster intervals. Report unresolved, pushes and all markets/sides; no cherry-picking.
protocol.limitations: Selected ranking-board cohort, not complete player population. Source revision and missing-context limitations remain. Models were developed on earlier inspected cohorts. Upcoming targets are new; only completion after this capture is eligible. Small samples cannot justify promotion; no fixed promised accuracy.
